request.title: Scan Obsidian vault for tasks that could become puddle requests
request.initialDescription: Manually reviewing an Obsidian vault to spot tasks or recurring frustrations that could be turned into puddle requests is slow and easy to miss. A tool that reads the vault and surfaces candidates would make puddle intake much faster.
request.currentProcess: Open Obsidian, read through notes manually, notice something that could be automated, remember to raise a puddle request.

specification.desiredOutcome: Search an Obsidian vault for open task lines and list them with the file each came from, as candidates for puddle requests.
specification.problemStatement: Manually reviewing an Obsidian vault to spot tasks or recurring frustrations that could be turned into puddle requests is slow and easy to miss. A tool that reads the vault and surfaces candidates would make puddle intake much faster.
